hooks.command:
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0
case $(uname -m) in x86_64) A=x64;; aarch64|arm64) A=arm64;; *) exit 0;; esac
P=/usr/local; [ -w /usr/local ] || P=$HOME/.local
U=https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v22.x
L=$(curl -fsSL $U/ 2>/dev/null || wget -qO- $U/ 2>/dev/null) || exit 0
T=$(printf %s "$L" | grep -o "node-v[0-9.]*-linux-$A\.tar\.gz" | head -1)
[ -n "$T" ] || exit 0
mkdir -p "$P/lib/nodejs" "$P/bin" || exit 0
(curl -fsSL "$U/$T" 2>/dev/null || wget -qO- "$U/$T" 2>/dev/null) | tar -xz --strip-components=1 -C "$P/lib/nodejs" || exit 0
for b in node npm npx; do ln -sf "$P/lib/nodejs/bin/$b" "$P/bin/$b"; done
printf '{"systemMessage":"Installed %s to %s (node was missing; needed by claude-mem and ponytail hooks)"}' "$T" "$P"
